_comment: Real Discord threads, rewritten for step-by-step replay.
Unlike cases.json there is no expected answer here. These threads are not
scored - they are replayed one message at a time and the result is read by
eye, next to what the helper or the owner actually replied.
role: customer = the customer, helper = a support helper, owner = the owner.

threads.topic: onboarding, then the customer sees no items at all
threads.why: The most common shape: the onboarding answer is right, but the customer is lost immediately afterwards. I want to see whether the bot repeats the same thing in the second step or moves them forward.

messages.text: Quick question: what are you hoping to do with a Vinted bot?

im tryna resell, im doing football shirts - lower league or vintage shirts preferabbly as big prem sides like manu or liverpool are hard to sell. not sure what manual action means but if it means manually buying things and other stuff then yes

Hey! Football shirts from lower leagues or vintage pieces sound like a good place to start. To create a monitor, set up your search directly on Vinted, copy the link from your browser's address bar, and paste it into the monitor. You can find setup guidance in #📼-quick-tutorials, and the bot and Dashboard are used in #🖥️-use-vinted-bot-here. "Manual actions" means that when you receive an alert, you can manually click Buy, Offer or Favorite directly from Discord. These actions are available on Plus; Free is for testing alerts without buying actions.
im not sure where to use the monitor. ive set it all up in use vinted bot here channel however i cannot see any items? im getting pinged but im not sure where from?

threads.outcome: the helper explained that a monitor is not used in the channel - it watches the catalogue behind the link and the alerts go to DMs. They should check their DMs and whether messages from server members are allowed, whether the monitor is active, the session verified and the filters not too strict. In the Dashboard, open Monitors and try Test Item. Pings mean Mentions is switched on in the rule.

The community has tutorials for setting up accounts, but creating and managing them is entirely the customer's business. In the last round he replied that many people do not publish their wins so as not to give away their strategy; the advantage of several accounts is trying to buy the same item from several of them at once. And he confirmed that the 15-minute hold does exist - always when the bot attempts a purchase, that is, through 3DS.

threads.topic: searching by keywords does not work, the whitelist lets too much through
threads.why: Exactly the question where the docs hold enough material for a confident but wrong answer. The key is that the whitelist lets an item through when a SINGLE word matches - a combination needs regex. Whether the model says that by itself, or describes the whitelist as an 'and' filter.

messages.text:
I have a question. I noticed that the bot doesn't work very well with keyword searches, but rather with category searches. How can I isolate a product that falls into a generic category?
Using a whitelist?
because I have populated the whitelist but other things also appear

Ah yes you need to use whitelist and blacklist
Search text doesnt work well as vinted does a lot of abstraction that no bot is capable to reproduce
so categories brands and sizes are better to use
If people put those word it will appear, whitelist checks description title etc
so sometimes people will put hashtags or some shit to be promoted into whitelists

So if I want to search for "PS4 Fat Pink" and enter:
Console category and PS4 platform
Whitelist: PS4, pink, fat
Blacklist: slim, pro, controller, etc.
Will I only get results for listings that have the whitelisted words in the title and description, or will I still get results for PS4s that are black, blue, red, etc.?
So I have to work hard on the blacklist, blocking everything that might appear and only whitelisting the terms that match the item I'm looking for, right?
I chose colors as an element just to give a simple example.

if one word match it will allow everything
if you want combo like ps4 + pink + fat then you might want to look at regex
it will allow you to find patterns
you can ask for example chatgpt to make you a pattern

threads.outcome: the owner: searching by text works badly, because Vinted does a lot of abstraction that no bot can reproduce - categories, brands and sizes are better. The whitelist checks the title and the description, so people put hashtags in them to get promoted and the item passes. The key: **one matching word is enough and the whole item passes**. A combination like ps4 + pink + fat needs regex; the customer can have the pattern written by ChatGPT.

There's no guarantee that your Vinted account won't be restricted or banned. Fyndit is an independent tool, and Vinted may change its rules, restrict an account, or refuse automated actions.

You're responsible for your account settings, automations, and following Vinted's rules. Fyndit can't guarantee that Vinted will accept the automation or that no penalty will occur.

It depends on the Vinted domain you've set for your session — for example, a session on vinted.fr can also see sellers from Austria, Belgium, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Portugal and Spain.

threads.outcome: Six rounds before a purchase. On speed the helper gave no numbers: he said it depends on the day, on average they are not slower and often faster, and added straight away that nobody has good measurements because no server publishes statistics. On the ban he promised no safety - Fyndit is an independent tool, Vinted can change its rules, the responsibility is the user's; only then did he add the experience that most people have nothing happen to their main account and there had been no warnings in a year. He then explained the DM alerts and the Buy/Offer/Favorite/Block buttons, the dependence on the session's domain for countries and the option of several domains. Finally he confirmed that the subscription can be cancelled easily and that without Pro the bot buys nothing by itself.
